title: Depot

lists.dispatchees: Dispatched: handed over, waiting for the courier or the driver
lists.enlivraison: Out for delivery: picked up, on the way to the customer
lists.returning: Returns on the way back to the depot
lists.exchange: Exchanges in progress at the customer (the old product will come back)

help.dispatchees: Parcels scanned and handed over. They leave this list as soon as the courier or the driver changes their status (picked up, out for delivery, delivered…). Those that stay must be checked: orange = more than 24 h, red = more than 48 h without news.
help.enlivraison: Parcels picked up by the courier or the driver, on the way to the customer. They leave this list when delivered, in alert or returning. Orange = 4 days, red = 7 days or more.

filters.searchPh: Name, phone, ref. PX…, tracking no.

removeTitle: Remove the courier: goes back to Preparing

receive.title: Receive a return
receive.help: Stock is put back automatically when the parcel is marked “Received at the depot”.
receive.ph: Scan or type the ref. PX…, the tracking no. or the phone

ph.ruptureHint: To bring to the depot — added to the “To bring” list
ph.notifyHint: The message is ready. WhatsApp lets you choose who to send it to.
ph.msgHead: Hello, please bring to the depot:
ph.copyFail: Could not copy: select the text
ph.nothingToPick: Everything is taken. Complete orders are in “Preparing”.
ph.readyHelp: All the products of these orders were taken. Tick the packed ones, then choose the partner.

stg.dispatchHelp: Packed orders with their delivery partner. Scan each parcel when the driver takes it: it moves to “Dispatched”.
stg.title_dispatchees: Handed over, waiting for the partner
stg.title_enlivraison: On the way to the customer
stg.empty_returning: No return on its way to the depot.
stg.returningHelp: Tap “Received at the depot” when the parcel arrives: the stock comes back.
stg.exchangeHelp: The new product is at the customer’s; the old one will come back to the depot.

labels.waitingN_one: {{count}} parcel waits for its company’s tracking number
labels.waitingN_other: {{count}} parcels wait for their company’s tracking number
labels.notSent_one: {{count}} parcel not sent to the company
labels.notSent_other: {{count}} parcels not sent to the company
labels.skipped_one: {{count}} without a label: company or tracking number missing
labels.skipped_other: {{count}} without a label: company or tracking number missing
labels.help: A label is printed once the parcel has its delivery company. A company with an API gives its own tracking number and its own label; the Pilotix label (10 × 15 cm) is for your own livreurs, companies without an API and those that give none (Procolis).
labels.cancelText: {{ref}} already has its {{name}} tracking number ({{tracking}}). It will be cancelled at {{name}} and the order goes back to “To prepare”.
labels.cancelOk: Cancel at the company and remove
labels.title: Parcel labels
labels.exchangeHint: Collect the old product from the customer
labels.notGot_one: {{count}} label not received from the company
labels.notGot_other: {{count}} labels not received from the companies
labels.companyHelp: Each company gives its own labels (ZR: one PDF for all its parcels). Open each file, then print it from the tab that opens.
labels.demoStandIn: Demo: stands in for {{name}}’s official label (with its API keys, its own label prints)

bags.title: Pickup bags · {{name}}
bags.help: Parcels handed to {{name}}’s driver go in a bag made here. Print the bag’s label and stick it on: {{name}} scans the bag and processes its parcels. Everything is done from Pilotix.
bags.waitingN_one: {{count}} dispatched parcel is waiting for a bag
bags.waitingN_other: {{count}} dispatched parcels are waiting for a bag
bags.noneWaiting: Every dispatched parcel is in a bag.
bags.skippedN_one: {{count}} parcel can’t go in a bag (not at ZR, already in a bag or already picked up)
bags.skippedN_other: {{count}} parcels can’t go in a bag (not at ZR, already in a bag or already picked up)
bags.label: Bag label
bags.dropConfirm: Delete bag {{bag}}? Its parcels will wait for a new bag.
bags.noLabel: {{name}} gave no label for this bag
bags.sheetDemo: Demo: stands in for {{name}}’s bag label (with its API keys, {{name}}’s own label prints)
bags.bulkNone: None of these parcels can go in a bag: not at ZR, already in a bag, or already picked up by the company
